August 30 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 423)

This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on August 30 across American network radio, British modern jazz broadcasting, and landmark fantasy audio dramatizations, The Mind's Eye audio adaptations of J.R.R. Tolkien's The Hobbit and Kenneth Grahame's The Wind in the Willows (1983–1985), Bing Crosby and Rosemary Clooney singing Anything Goes with Buddy Cole (1961), British tenor saxophonist Tubby Hayes on Play It Cool (1964), Blake Edwards' hard-hitting police procedural The Line-Up (1951), and Lum and Abner planning a St. Louis trip for Frigidaire (1948–1985):
